title.zh-CN: 北京马拉松：分段累计距离
title.en: Beijing Marathon: cumulative distance by segment

note.zh-CN: 累计距离按 2026 参赛指南列出的计时点（每 5 公里、半程与终点）排列；官方未公布可下载的 GPX/KML，本图不读取分段爬升。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Cumulative distance follows the timing points listed in the 2026 participant guide (every 5 km, halfway and finish); no downloadable official GPX/KML exists, and this chart reads no per-segment climb. Self-made chart, not an official course profile.

title.zh-CN: 北京马拉松：按 5:30:00 目标完赛算，官方关门点余量（2026 届）
title.en: Beijing Marathon: official cut-off buffer per gate at a 5:30:00 target (2026)

unit.zh-CN: 分钟（正值为余量，负值为已超关门）

note.zh-CN: 按 2026 参赛指南关门表与 07:30 发枪、目标 5:30:00 完赛匀速推算；余量＝关门时刻−预计到达。正值为在关门前到达，负值表示已超关门。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Computed from the 2026 participant-guide cut-off table, an 07:30 gun and an even pace to a 5:30:00 finish; buffer = cut-off minus predicted arrival. Positive values are inside the gate; negative values mean outside it. Self-made chart, not an official course profile.
